title: Holding my Grandson
synopsis: Old Lady Wang’s daughter-in-law has already lost two babies. Will her daughter-in-law’s third pregnancy give her the grandson that she’s always wanted.

fullText.simplified:
娘家妈不放心女儿，她问医生：“大人小孩都能活着吗？”
    “少说话！”王老太太瞪了娘家妈一眼。
    “我相信没危险，”医生急得直流汗，“可是小孩已经误了半天了，保不保得住，我也不敢确定。要不然，请你签字干嘛？”
    “不确定啊？那还掏干什么呀？”王老太太心想：可不是吗？掏了半天都不是活的，对得起谁？
    “好吧，”医生气得直发抖，“你们把她抬回去吧！你可记住了，两条人命！”
    “两条三条，你又不确定能保，这不是骗人吗？”
    医生没说话，转头走了。
    王老太太这才想起来，试试也好啊！要不是医生要走，她还想不起这个来呢：“医生，医生！你回来，回来啊！试试吧！”
    医生气得不知是哭好还是笑好，把笔拿给她，她在上面签了字。
    两家人在手术室外面等了不知道多久，眼看天就快亮了，才掏了出来。
    好大的孙子，6公斤重！王老太太拉着娘家妈的手，一边笑，一边哭。现在，娘家妈不是仇人了，变成了好姐姐；医生也不是骗子了，变成了大好人！要不是这一掏，这么个大胖小子没有了，那可怎么行啊？王老太太高兴得呀，真想马上给子孙娘娘上香，可惜医院里没有子孙娘娘。

    胖孙子已经被洗好，放在小儿室里。两位老太太要进去看看。不只是看看，她们要用一个晚上没洗过的老手指去摸摸孙子的胖脸。
    护士不给两位老太太进去，只能在窗外看。眼看着自己的孙子在里面，自己的孙子，连摸摸都不给吗？王老太太不高兴了。
fullText.traditional:
娘家媽不放心女兒，她問醫生：“大人小孩都能活著嗎？”
    “少說話！”王老太太瞪了娘家媽一眼。
    “我相信沒危險，”醫生急得直流汗，“可是小孩已經誤了半天了，保不保得住，我也不敢確定。要不然，請你簽字幹嘛？”
    “不確定啊？那還掏幹什麼呀？”王老太太心想：可不是嗎？掏了半天都不是活的，對得起誰？
    “好吧，”醫生氣得直發抖，“你們把她抬回去吧！你可記住了，兩條人命！”
    “兩條三條，你又不確定能保，這不是騙人嗎？”
    醫生沒說話，轉頭走了。
    王老太太這才想起來，試試也好啊！要不是醫生要走，她還想不起這個來呢：“醫生，醫生！你回來，回來啊！試試吧！”
    醫生氣得不知是哭好還是笑好，把筆拿給她，她在上面簽了字。
    兩家人在手術室外面等了不知道多久，眼看天就快亮了，才掏了出來。
    好大的孫子，6公斤重！王老太太拉著娘家媽的手，一邊笑，一邊哭。現在，娘家媽不是仇人了，變成了好姐姐；醫生也不是騙子了，變成了大好人！要不是這一掏，這麼個大胖小子沒有了，那可怎麼行啊？王老太太高興得呀，真想馬上給子孫娘娘上香，可惜醫院裡沒有子孫娘娘。

    胖孫子已經被洗好，放在小兒室裡。兩位老太太要進去看看。不只是看看，她們要用一個晚上沒洗過的老手指去摸摸孫子的胖臉。
    護士不給兩位老太太進去，只能在窗外看。眼看著自己的孫子在裡面，自己的孫子，連摸摸都不給嗎？王老太太不高興了。

sentences.pinyin: yào bu shì zhè yì tāo zhè me ge dà pàng xiǎo zǐ méi yǒu le nà kě zěn me xíng a

sentences.pinyin: liǎng wèi lǎo tài tai yào jìn qù kàn kan

sentences.traditional: 不只是看看，

sentences.english: Not only did they want to see the baby, ..

sentences.traditional: 她們要用一個晚上沒洗過的老手指去摸摸孫子的胖臉。

sentences.english: The nurse didn’t let the two old ladies in. They could only look from outside the window.

sentences.traditional: 眼看著自己的孫子在裡面，自己的孫子，連摸摸都不給嗎？

sentences.english: Their eyes looked upon their grandson inside. Their own grandson that they weren’t even allowed to touch?

sentences.simplified: 王老太太不高兴了。
sentences.traditional: 王老太太不高興了。
sentences.pinyin: wáng lǎo tài tai bù gāo xìng le
sentences.english: Old Lady Wang was not happy.

raw.synopsis: Old Lady Wang’s daughter-in-law has already lost two babies. Will her daughter-in-law’s third pregnancy give her the grandson that she’s always wanted.
sentence_translations: The daughter-in-law’s mother did not feel at ease about her daughter. She asked the doctor, ..
.. “Will the adult and the child both be able to live?”
“Keep quiet!” Old Lady Wang glared at her daughter-in-law’s mother.
“I believe there is no danger,“ the doctor was so anxious that he sweated.
“But the child has already been delayed for half a day. Whether or not it can be saved, I don’t dare say with certainty.
Otherwise, why would we ask you to sign?”
“You’re not certain? Then why are we even scooping it out?” Old Lady Wang thought to herself, is that not right?
If you scoop it out for half a day and it’s still not alive, everyone will be let down.
“Alright then,” the doctor was so angry that he continuously trembled.
“You carry her back then! But you remember, this is two human lives!”
“Two lives, three lives. You aren’t certain that they can be saved. Is this not a scam?
The doctor didn’t say anything, and turned around and left.
Old Lady Wang only then thought, it might be good to give it a go!
If it wasn’t for the doctor attempting to leave, she wouldn’t have thought of it.
“Doctor, doctor! Come back, come back! Let’s give it a go!”
The doctor was so angry that he didn’t know whether to cry or laugh.
He gave her a pen and she signed in the place.
The two families waited for who knows how long outside the operating room.
It was soon almost dawn when the baby was finally scooped out.
A very big grandson, weighing 6 kilograms!
Old Lady Wang held the hand of her daughter-in-law’s mother, laughing and crying at the same time.
Now, her daughter-in-law’s mother was not an enemy, she had become a good elder sister.
The doctor was not a scam, he had become a good person!
If it were not for scooping out the baby, this big, fat boy would’ve died. How could that be acceptable?
Old Lady Wang was so happy that she really wanted to immediately light incense for the goddess of fertility.
Unfortunately, there was no goddess of fertility inside the hospital.
The fat grandson had already been washed and placed inside the nursery.
The two old ladies wanted go in to see the baby.
Not only did they want to see the baby, ..
.. they wanted to touch their grandson’s fat face with their old fingers they hadn’t washed the entire night.
The nurse didn’t let the two old ladies in. They could only look from outside the window.
Their eyes looked upon their grandson inside. Their own grandson that they weren’t even allowed to touch?
Old Lady Wang was not happy.
